docs_description: A component library for SolidJS built with Ark UI, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack.
docs_component_accordion_description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that reveal content.
docs_component_alert_dialog_description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content.
docs_component_angle_slider_description: A circular slider for selecting angles and rotational values.
docs_component_aspect_ratio_description: Displays content within a desired ratio.
docs_component_avatar_description: An image element with a fallback to represent the user.
docs_component_badge_description: A small label component for status or counts.
docs_component_breadcrumb_description: A navigation component showing the current location in a hierarchy.
docs_component_button_description: A clickable button component with multiple variants.
docs_component_card_description: A container component for displaying grouped content.
docs_component_carousel_description: A slideshow component for cycling through elements.
docs_component_checkbox_description: A control that allows users to toggle between checked and unchecked states.
docs_component_collapsible_description: An interactive component that expands and collapses content.
docs_component_combobox_description: An autocomplete input with a filterable dropdown list.
docs_component_date_picker_description: A calendar-based input for selecting dates.
docs_component_dialog_description: A modal window that appears over the main content.
docs_component_empty_description: A placeholder component for empty states.
docs_component_field_description: A wrapper component for form inputs with labels and errors.
docs_component_form_description: A comprehensive form component with validation and various field types.
docs_component_hover_card_description: A card that appears when hovering over an element.
docs_component_input_group_description: A wrapper for grouping inputs with addons and buttons.
docs_component_item_description: A flexible item component for lists and menus.
docs_component_kbd_description: A component for displaying keyboard shortcuts.
docs_component_label_description: A text label for form controls.
docs_component_link_description: A styled anchor component for navigation.
docs_component_marquee_description: A scrolling text or content component.
docs_component_menu_description: A dropdown menu with actions and options.
docs_component_navigation_menu_descripti: A horizontal navigation component with dropdowns.
docs_component_number_input_description: An input component for numeric values with increment and decrement.
docs_component_pagination_description: A navigation component for paginated content.
docs_component_password_input_descriptio: A text input with visibility toggle for passwords.
docs_component_pin_input_description: A segmented input for entering PIN codes.
docs_component_popover_description: A floating panel that appears next to a trigger element.
docs_component_progress_description: A visual indicator showing completion progress.
docs_component_radio_group_description: A set of radio buttons for selecting a single option.
docs_component_select_description: A dropdown component for selecting from a list of options.
docs_component_separator_description: A visual divider between content sections.
docs_component_sheet_description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.
docs_component_skeleton_description: A placeholder component for loading states.
docs_component_slider_description: A control for selecting a value from a range.
docs_component_switch_description: A toggle control for binary settings.
docs_component_table_description: A component for displaying tabular data.
docs_component_tabs_description: A navigation component for switching between content panels.
docs_component_tags_input_description: An input for entering and managing multiple tags.
docs_component_text_input_description: A styled text input with various states.
docs_component_toaster_description: A notification system for displaying toast messages.
docs_component_toggle_description: A two-state button that can be toggled on or off.
docs_component_tooltip_description: A popup that displays information when hovering over an element.
docs_component_tree_view_description: A hierarchical list component for nested data.
docs_component_typography_description: Text components for consistent typography styling.
docs_component_sidebar_description: A collapsible sidebar with menus, groups, headers, and footers.
